_note: Publisher settings (publish/run.mjs). Tier A = official facts written by code (events, status, dates). A run that would change more tracked entries than max_entries_changed_per_run is treated as an anomaly: nothing is written. auto_publish switches stay off until the field scores at the bar on the accuracy test set (phase 4).

links._note: The links step of update.mjs (links/run.mjs). For every entry added or changed in a run, code proposes links (a lead sponsor already in the network, a bill amending a tracked law). AI links need a quote from both bills found by code and the validator's agreement. While auto_publish.relationships is off, proposals are only listed in the run report under Links proposed; when on, links/apply.mjs adds them (additions only, checked by publish/guards.mjs). Code-only backtest: node links/backtest.mjs.

eval_bar._note: Set by the owner. A field may auto-publish only when the latest test-set report (eval/run.mjs) for the production model meets all three: share of in-scope test items whose field passes, published fields with an unsupported quote or number, and scope agreement.

ai_step._note: The AI step of update.mjs (agents on material changes and new-bill candidates). max_items_per_run bounds one run; the monthly cap in config/models.json bounds the month. New-bill drafts are published by Tier B (publish/tier-b.mjs) only when auto_publish.new_entries is on, at most max_new_entries_per_run per run; while it is off they are reported as ready.

self_correction._note: The self-correction step of update.mjs (correct/run.mjs). Once a day it reads every tracked bill's official text (free APIs), and re-checks up to max_entries_per_run entries against it: text changed first, then failed checks (up to max_retries), then entries never checked, then the one checked longest ago (after recheck_after_days). The reader (role reviewer) proposes; the confirmer (role confirmer) must agree; code checks quotes and numbers. Only mechanism, thresholds and penalties change. Every entry may be corrected, hand-written ones included (owner, 27 Oct 2026).

notify._note: Telegram run report after every run (needs TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN or TELEGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID). A dry run sends one only with --notify.
